title: XLIST-HATE: A CHECKLIST-BASED FRAMEWORK FOR INTERPRETABLE AND GENERALIZABLE HATE SPEECH DETECTION

bias_targets.methodology: Cross-dataset evaluation (measuring relative AUC and Out-Of-Domain AUC) comparing checklist-based diagnostic models against supervised fine-tuning to assess robustness against dataset-specific labeling criteria, annotator subjectivity, and training data artifacts.

Evaluating model performance on hate speech detection benchmarks (e.g., Measuring Hate Speech, HateCheck, HateXplain) using a structured diagnostic checklist that identifies targeting, derogation, and dehumanization directed at protected demographic groups (e.g., race, religion, gender, sexual orientation).
